name: Website Knowledge Sync
description: Periodically crawls and extracts structured knowledge from a target website to build a persistent Knowledge Graph.

config.objective: Build and maintain a comprehensive Knowledge Graph of the target website's products, services, and policies.

website_url.description: The root URL to start scanning from

config.goal: Identify the navigation structure, find product catalog pages, pricing tables, and FAQ sections. Extract DOM snapshots for each major page found.

config.systemPrompt: You are a specialized Prospector Agent. From the provided DOM snapshots, extract: 1. Entities (Product, Service, Plan). 2. Relationships. 3. Page Themes (e.g., 'Enterprise Scalability', 'Compliance Guide'). Output as KnowledgeNodes and KnowledgeEdges.
